969-2023-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-4659-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-4659-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1168-1479-2841-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1168-1479-2841-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

628-728-7199.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

2935-7841-8089.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

225-2557-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3375-4399-4476-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4476-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1796-4217-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
1251-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-1780-2499.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve both Burdened Aerialist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2241-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites:
You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
You have not cast a spell using Serra Paragon this turn.
2241-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from your graveyard by paying {1}{W}
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

4052-6264.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
4052-6264.description:
During your cleanup step, discard down to your maximum hand size.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each card discarded this way.
When the Zombie(s) enter the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers that many times, causing you to draw that many cards.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat from step 2.

3358-4881-6965.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1978-4002-5793.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-5793.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat

2173-3661-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

549-2919-4186-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2919-4186-6890.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating an artifact creature token.
Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

5572-5686-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5572-5686-6249--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

224-1846-5352-6657-6820.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1846-5352-6657-6820.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Doppelgang by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Holding priority, activate Overloaded Mage-Ring by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting the Doppelgang spell.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Overloaded Mage-Ring ability, targeting the Doppelgang spell.
Resolve the copy of Overloaded Mage-Ring's ability, copying the Doppelgang spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

971-1995-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
971-1995-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

1497-2376-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-2376-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

654-1479-5671-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5671-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-1115-2511.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1115-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

413-2178-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
413-2178-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

152-3604-4155.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of The Stasis Coffin.
Activate the Stasis Coffin token by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

1003-3410-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {U/B}.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3621-4050-5140.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {B}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-2577-4871.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Gravecrawler dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-3756-4488.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3756-4488.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1315-1721-2824-3505.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control that enter the battlefield untapped can produce at least {7}{W}{W}.
1315-1721-2824-3505.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{W}{W}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat step 2 for each other land you control.
Activate Codex Shredder by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Second Sunrise from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all artifacts, lands, creatures and enchantments that were put into a graveyard this turn onto the battlefield under their owner's control.
Sunscorched Desert enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player.
Repeat.
1315-1721-2824-3505.notes: This combo also works with one less mana available from lands, producing every results except the infinite mana.

141-2596-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2596-4050.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.
